description: This file contains a class and function for rewriting do-while loops into an equivalent form to improve shader compiler support, including AST traversal and transformation logic.

classes.name: DoWhileRewriter
classes.description: AST traverser class that rewrites do-while loops into an equivalent form with a boolean flag and a while loop.

methods.name: visitBlock
methods.description: Traverses AST blocks to identify and replace do-while loops with an equivalent construct.

methods.name: RewriteDoWhile
methods.description: Function that applies the DoWhileRewriter to the AST root node and validates the transformed AST.
